verifierInput: ordered event records with operation codes, pre-state digest, proposed tuple, signature booleans, and commit observation
signed view tuples containing log identity, tree size, root, issuer, subject, sequence, and statement digest
withheld: fixture name and human-readable attack label
allowedRules: A committed event changes all tuple fields named by that event; an uncommitted event changes none.
A nonce already present in the retained spent set cannot authorize another successor.
A rotation requires exact predecessor epoch plus one and valid predecessor-key and new-key authorization.
A checkpoint lower than an independently retained generation or with the same generation and different digest is refused.
Two views with the same log identity and tree size but different roots are an equivocation.
Two statements with the same issuer, subject, and sequence but different digests are an issuer equivocation.
A lower tree size than a retained view is stale; a consistent strictly advancing view is accepted.
output: reason code computed only from the allowed rules
aggregate exact-match count after the sealed output is compared by the adjudicator
failure: The blind gate fails if the verifier reads any withheld field, cannot reconstruct a case, or disagrees with either implementation on any verdict or state digest.
